description: Paid: 0.005 RLUSD per call via x402 on XRPL mainnet (xrpl:0), or 0.005 USDC on Base (eip155:8453). AI provider health reading. Use before an agent calls an AI provider: the vendor's own status-page indicator and active incidents, the share of disturbed checks in the last 24h of our record (checked every 10 min), and a reading (go, caution, no_go, unknown) with a suggested-handling flag. Each reading lists its source and time. Some providers are no longer measured (status null until 2026-11-12). Not affiliated with any source. Without payment this returns isError with the x402 PaymentRequired object (fresh invoiceId); retry with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"] or the payment_signature argument. Unpaid calls cost nothing.

payment_signature.description: Optional. Base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value (signed RLUSD or USDC PaymentPayload) for hosts that cannot set _meta["x402/payment"]. Omit on the first call to receive the payment requirements.

provider.description: Vendor slug (status feeds: anthropic, morph; others return unknown) or a model id like anthropic/claude-sonnet-4
